svg.title: Viventium 0.5 — One Soul. Everything connected.
svg.desc: Target product architecture. The user reaches one Soul through a horizontal channel row. Channels connect down to Viventium Core, powered by xPerfect as its intelligence unit. Inside xPerfect are Codex, Claude Code and Grok harnesses, with official marks, plus room for more. Emotional Reactions are inside the Subconscious and update shared Feeling state. Life, Sleep and Scheduling join a shared surfacing path to Continuity, the same Main. Workbench supplies shared instructions for waking and nightly work. Cognitive SDK is a target design, not a shipped implementation claim. Bio Lab includes Feelings with emotional state and baselines or default personality; Subconscious workers with emotional reactions and anti-sycophancy; Continuity or Conscious Stream; and proposed integrations. Prompt Workbench is advanced tooling. Life, sleep and dreaming, and scheduling are built in. Journey: install, connect accounts, connect channels, use, automatic upkeep.

g.text: A personal AI built from shared cognitive patterns: memory, character, useful work and continuity.
Coordinates these AI harnesses, their tools and background workers.
One cognitive system. Shared building blocks.
Features that give the Soul life
Context + insights + due opportunities → same Main decides
Build a deeper connection over time.
Shape how the whole system behaves.
Guidance for Main and its workers.
Prompt IDs, inputs and shared context.
Sources, live behaviour and run history.
Reuse the same patterns across channels, harnesses, background work and scheduled work.
Conceptual connections; runtime owners may differ.
